name: NEW REPLIES REGRESSION SET
source: Derived from the 111 production threads in New Replies on 2026-10-01 (frozen under the job tmp dir) plus the 7.2 owner test table. De-identified: every person name is replaced by a fictional placeholder (Pat, Sam, Dana, Lee, Kim), every street by 123 Main St / Oak Ave, every number in our outbound by a neutral figure. No phone, email or real address. Seller wording, spelling, punctuation and language are kept, because the wording IS the signal.
contract: It is a regression set, not the universe: each row pins a SEMANTIC, not a one-off string. context = the use case of OUR previous outbound (null = no validated question). expected.new_replies = keep | remove.
